41603.meaning1: name of a mountain near Rājagaha

41607.meaning1: wise; intelligent; astute; learned; knowledgeable; skilled
41607.synonym: ñāṇī, dhīra, nipaka, nipuṇa, pañña, paññavant, paññāṇavant, paññāvant, matimant, matīmant, mutimant, mutīmant, viññujātika, viññū, sapañña, sappañña

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, gāvī pabbateyyā paṇḍitā byattā khettaññū kusalā visame pabbate carituṃ.
dvīhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato paṇḍito viyatto sappuriso akkhataṃ anupahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati anavajjo ca hoti ananuvajjo ca viññūnaṃ bahuñ'ca puññaṃ pasavati.

41608.meaning1: sage; intelligent person; wise man; smart person
41608.commentary: (MNa) bāle ca paṇḍite cā'ti bālā ca paṇḍitā ca.

examples.text: selo yathā ekaghano, vātena na samīrati, evaṃ nindāpasaṃsāsu, na samiñjanti paṇḍitā.
yaṃ taṃ apucchimha akittayī no, aññaṃ taṃ pucchāma tadiṅgha brūhi, ettāvat'aggaṃ nu vadanti h'eke, yakkhassa suddhiṃ idha paṇḍitāse, udāhu aññam'pi vadanti etto.
aho vata re amhākaṃ paṇḍitaka, aho vata re amhākaṃ bahussutaka, aho vata re amhākaṃ tevijjaka
atha kho abhayo ca licchavi paṇḍitakumārako ca licchavi yen'āyasmā ānando ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
yasmiṃ padese kappeti, vāsaṃ paṇḍitajātiyo, sīlavant'ettha bhojetvā, saññate brahmacārayo.

41613.meaning1: wiser; more intelligent; more astute; cleverer (than)

examples.text: atthi, deva, govindassa brāhmaṇassa jotipālo nāma māṇavo putto paṇḍitataro c'eva pitarā, alam'atthadasataro c'eva pitarā, ye'pi'ssa pitā atthe anusāsi, te'pi jotipālass'eva māṇavassa anusāsaniyā'ti. evaṃ kumārā'ti?

41615.meaning1: sign of a wise person; indication of an intelligent person

examples.text: tīṇ'imāni, bhikkhave, paṇḍitassa paṇḍitalakkhaṇāni paṇḍitanimittāni paṇḍit'āpadānāni. katamāni tīṇi?

41616.meaning1: prescribed by the wise; recommended by the intelligent
41616.commentary: (ANa) paṇḍitapaññattānī'ti paṇḍitehi paññattāni kathitāni pasatthāni. (ANt) paṇḍitapaññattānī'ti paṇḍitehi paṭhamaṃ paññattāni.

examples.text: katamāni tīṇi? dānaṃ, bhikkhave, paṇḍitapaññattaṃ sappurisapaññattaṃ. pabbajjā, bhikkhave, paṇḍitapaññattā sappurisapaññattā.

41617.meaning1: characteristics of a wise person and a fool
41617.commentary: (MNa) bālalakkhaṇānī'ti bālo ayan'ti etehi lakkhiyati ñāyatī'ti bālalakkhaṇāni.

41620.meaning1: level of the wise person; realm of the intelligent person
41620.commentary: (MNa) kevalā paripūrā paṇḍitabhūmī'ti paṇḍito tīṇi sucaritāni pūretvā sagge nibbattati, tato manussalokaṃ āgacchanto kularūpabhogasampattiyaṃ nibbattati, tattha ṭhito tīṇi ca sucaritāni pūretvā puna sagge nibbattatī'ti ayaṃ sakalā paripuṇṇā paṇḍitabhūmi.

examples.text: atha kho ayam'eva tato mahantataro kaṭaggaho yaṃ so paṇḍito kāyena sucaritaṃ caritvā, vācāya sucaritaṃ caritvā, manasā sucaritaṃ caritvā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, kevalā paripūrā paṇḍitabhūmī'ti.
tīṇ'imāni, bhikkhave, paṇḍitassa paṇḍitalakkhaṇāni paṇḍitanimittāni paṇḍit'āpadānāni. katamāni tīṇi?

41624.meaning1: skilful speaker; intelligent orator; (comm) believing one is wise

examples.text: disvāna bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, ayaṃ, bhante, saccako nigaṇṭhaputto āgacchati bhassappavādako paṇḍitavādo sādhusammato bahujanassa.

41625.meaning1: understandable by the wise; comprehensible to the intelligent

examples.text: tathā hi ayam'āyasmā na c'eva gambhīraṃ atthapadaṃ udāharati santaṃ paṇītaṃ atakk'āvacaraṃ nipuṇaṃ paṇḍitavedanīyaṃ.

41626.meaning1: characteristic of a wise person; manifestation of an intelligent person

examples.text: tīṇ'imāni, bhikkhave, paṇḍitassa paṇḍitalakkhaṇāni paṇḍitanimittāni paṇḍit'āpadānāni. katamāni tīṇi?

41627.meaning1: speaking as if wise; talking as if intelligent

examples.text: parimuṭṭhā paṇḍitābhāsā, vācāgocarabhāṇino, yāv'icchanti mukh'āyāmaṃ, yena nītā na taṃ vidū.
seyyathā'pi, sunakkhatta, paṇḍupalāso bandhanā pavutto abhabbo haritattāya, evam'eva kho, sunakkhatta, āneñj'ādhimuttassa purisapuggalassa ye lok'āmisasaṃyojane se pavutte.
paṇḍupalāso'va dāni'si, yamapurisā'pi ca te upaṭṭhitā, uyyogamukhe ca tiṭṭhasi, pātheyyam'pi ca te na vijjati.

41629.commentary: (THIa) kisā paṇḍu vivaṇṇā cā'ti evaṃ ukkaṇṭhitabhāvena kisā dhamanisanthatagattā uppaṇḍ'uppaṇḍukajātā tato eva vivaṇṇā vigatachavivaṇṇā ca hutvā.

examples.text: kisā paṇḍu vivaṇṇā ca, satta vassāni cāri'haṃ, n'āhaṃ divā vā rattiṃ vā, sukhaṃ vindiṃ sudukkhitā.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, pūtimuttaṃ nānābhesajjehi saṃsaṭṭhaṃ. atha puriso āgaccheyya paṇḍukarogī.
te evam'āhaṃsu, paṇḍukarogino, mahārājā'ti.

41631.meaning2: name of one of the group of six monks

41632.meaning1: white woollen blanket; white woollen rug

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma maṇi veḷuriyo subho jātimā aṭṭh'aṃso suparikammakato paṇḍukambale nikkhitto bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca
disvā jaṭī kaṇhasiri'vhayo isi, suvaṇṇanikkhaṃ viya paṇḍukambale, setañ'ca chattaṃ dhariyanta muddhani, udaggacitto sumano paṭiggahe.

41633.meaning1: name of a flat rock in Tāvatiṃsa heaven
41633.commentary: (PVa) tāvatiṃse'ti tāvatiṃsabhavane. silāyaṃ paṇḍukambale'ti paṇḍukambalanāmake sil'āsane puris'uttamo buddho yadā vihāsī'ti yojanā. (NIDD1a) pāricchattakamūle'ti koviḷārarukkhassa heṭṭhā. paṇḍukambalasilāyan'ti rattakambalasadisapāsāṇapiṭṭhe.

examples.text: tāvatiṃse yadā buddho, silāyaṃ paṇḍukambale, pāricchattakamūlamhi, vihāsi puris'uttamo.
tato vikubbanaṃ katvā, jino devapuraṃ gato, vasate tattha sambuddho, silāya paṇḍukambale.

41634.meaning2: covered with a white woollen cloth

examples.text: rañño, ānanda, mahāsudassanassa… caturāsīti rathasahassāni ahesuṃ sīhacamma-parivārāni byagghacamma-parivārāni dīpicamma-parivārāni paṇḍukambalaparivārāni sovaṇṇ'ālaṅ'kārāni sovaṇṇadhajāni hemajālapaṭicchannāni vejayanta-ratha-ppamukhāni

41635.meaning1: name of a place in Tāvatiṃsa heaven
41635.meaningLit: rock spread with a pale coloured woollen cloth
41635.commentary: (MNa) paṇḍukambalasilāyan'ti rattakambalasilāyaṃ. tassā kira rattakambalass'eva jayasumanapuppharāsi viya vaṇṇo, tasmā paṇḍukambalasilā'ti vuccati.

examples.text: yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ, āvuso, dhāresi bhaddekarattiyo gāthā'ti? ekam'idaṃ, bhikkhu, samayaṃ bhagavā devesu tāvatiṃsesu viharati pāricchattakamūle paṇḍukambalasilāyaṃ. tatra bhagavā devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ bhadd'ekarattassa uddesañ'ca vibhaṅgañ'ca abhāsi.
tassa kira sakkena saddhiṃ paṇḍukambalasilāyaṃ nisinnassa akkhinimisamattena nānattaṃ paññāyati. taṃ asallakkhentā devā sakkassa ca tassa ca nānatte muyhanti.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, pūtimuttaṃ nānābhesajjehi saṃsaṭṭhaṃ. atha puriso āgaccheyya paṇḍukarogī. tam'enaṃ evaṃ vadeyyuṃ, ambho purisa, idaṃ pūtimuttaṃ nānābhesajjehi saṃsaṭṭhaṃ, sace ākaṅkhasi piva.

41637.meaning1: yellow leaf; pale leaf; withered leaf

examples.text: paṇḍupalāso'va dāni'si, yamapurisā'pi ca te upaṭṭhitā, uyyogamukhe ca tiṭṭhasi, pātheyyam'pi ca te na vijjati.

41638.meaning2: who is ready to leave household life

41640.meaning1: (of rice) made by a special process

examples.text: atha kho, ānanda, kikī kāsirājā tassā rattiyā accayena sake nivesane paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā paṇḍupuṭakassa sālino vigatakāḷakaṃ anekasūpaṃ anekabyañjanaṃ, kassapassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa kālaṃ ārocāpesi, kālo, bhante, niṭṭhitaṃ bhattan'ti.
tena kho pana samayena samīti yānakāraputto rathassa nemiṃ tacchati. tam'enaṃ paṇḍuputto ājīvako purāṇayānakāraputto paccupaṭṭhito hoti.
te tvaṃ evaṃ vadeyyāsi, tena hi, bho, tassa purisassa kāyaṃ paṇḍumattikāya tikkhattuṃ subbaṭṭitaṃ ubbaṭṭethā'ti.
seyyathā'pi, udāyi, maṇi veḷuriyo subho jātimā aṭṭh'aṃso suparikammakato accho vippasanno sabb'ākārasampanno, tatr'idaṃ suttaṃ āvutaṃ nīlaṃ vā pītaṃ vā lohitaṃ vā odātaṃ vā paṇḍusuttaṃ vā.
yassa mūlaṃ chamā n'atthi, paṇṇā n'atthi kuto latā, taṃ dhīraṃ bandhanā muttaṃ, ko taṃ ninditum'arahati. devā'pi naṃ pasaṃsanti, brahmunā'pi pasaṃsito'ti.
sabbattha munī anissito, na piyaṃ kubbati no'pi appiyaṃ, tasmiṃ paridevamaccharaṃ, paṇṇe vāri yathā na limpati.

so gāmaṃ pavisitvā, ammatātā, svātanāya mayā buddhappamukho bhikkhusaṅgho nimantito, tumhe yattakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ dātuṃ sakkhissatha, tattakānaṃ dānaṃ dethā'ti ārocetvā vicaranto attano attano balaṃ sallakkhetvā mayaṃ dasannaṃ dassāma, mayaṃ vīsatiyā, mayaṃ satassa, mayaṃ pañcasatānan'ti vutte sabbesaṃ vacanaṃ ādito paṭṭhāya paṇṇe āropesi.

41650.meaning2: leaf, leaf for writing upon, letter

41653.commentary: (SNa) paṇṇakuṭīsu sammantī'ti himavantapadese ramaṇīye araññ'āyatane rattiṭṭhāna-divāṭṭhāna-caṅkaman'ādīhi sampannāsu paṇṇasālāsu vasanti.

examples.text: bhūtapubbaṃ, assalāyana, sattannaṃ brāhmaṇ'isīnaṃ araññ'āyatane paṇṇakuṭīsu sammantānaṃ evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ hoti, brāhmaṇo'va seṭṭho vaṇṇo, hīno añño vaṇṇo
chattaṃ nāma tīṇi chattāni, setacchattaṃ, kilañjacchattaṃ, paṇṇacchattaṃ maṇḍalabaddhaṃ salākabaddhaṃ.

41655.meaning1: leaf umbrella; parasol made of leaves

examples.text: evarūpo vatthabhogo ahosi, sāṇaṃ dhāreti tipakkhavasanaṃ. evarūpo yānabhogo ahosi, jajjararathakena yāti paṇṇachattakena dhāriyamānenā'ti.

41656.commentary: (KVa) tattha yassā sacittakapakkhe cittaṃ akusalam'eva hoti, ayaṃ lokavajjā, sesā paṇṇattivajjā.

examples.text: udake hassadhammaṃ, mahārāja, lokassa anavajjaṃ, taṃ jinasāsane vajjaṃ. iti evarūpāni evarūpāni, mahārāja, jinasāsane vajjāni, idaṃ vuccati paṇṇattivajjaṃ.

41657.meaning1: name; designation; concept; description (of); what is called

examples.text: etadānuttariyaṃ, bhante, āyatanapaṇṇattīsu. taṃ bhagavā asesam'abhijānāti, taṃ bhagavato asesam'abhijānato uttari abhiññeyyaṃ n'atthi, yadabhijānaṃ añño samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā bhagavatā bhiyyo'bhiññataro assa yadidaṃ āyatanapaṇṇattīsu.

41658.meaning1: statutory offence; transgression only by decree
41658.commentary: (KVa) tattha yassā sacittakapakkhe cittaṃ akusalam'eva hoti, ayaṃ lokavajjā, sesā paṇṇattivajjā. sabbā ca kāyakamma-vacīkamma-tadubhaya-vasena tividhā honti.

examples.text: udake hassadhammaṃ, mahārāja, lokassa anavajjaṃ, taṃ jinasāsane vajjaṃ. iti evarūpāni evarūpāni, mahārāja, jinasāsane vajjāni, idaṃ vuccati paṇṇattivajjaṃ.
idaṃ pana paṭhamasikkhāpadaṃ yasmā lokavajjaṃ, na paṇṇattivajjaṃ, tasmā ayam'anupaññatti rundhantī dvāraṃ pidahantī sotaṃ pacchindamānā gāḷhataraṃ karontī uppajji.

examples.text: seyyaṃ nāma bhisi, cimilikā uttar'attharaṇaṃ, bhūm'attharaṇaṃ, taṭṭikā, cammakhaṇḍo, nisīdanaṃ, paccattharaṇaṃ, tiṇasanthāro, paṇṇasanthāro.
aṭṭhadosasamākiṇṇaṃ, pajahiṃ paṇṇasālakaṃ, upāgamiṃ rukkhamūlaṃ, guṇe dasah'upāgataṃ.
āma, samma, idāni ahaṃ vihāraṃ gantvā theraṃ tayā kāritapaṇṇasālāya nisinnakaṃ disvā āgatomhī'ti vatvā pakkāmi.
paṇṇavīsativassāni, yato pabbajitā ahaṃ, n'āccharāsaṅghātamattam'pi, cittass'ūpasam'ajjhagaṃ.
paṇṇavīsativassāni, yato pabbajitāya me, n'ābhijānāmi cittassa, samaṃ laddhaṃ kudācanaṃ.

taṃ kiṃ maññasi, mahārāja, tvaṃ vīsativass'uddesiko'pi paṇṇavīsativass'uddesiko'pi hatthismim'pi katāvī assasmim'pi katāvī rathasmim'pi katāvī dhanusmim'pi katāvī tharusmim'pi katāvī ūrubalī bāhubalī alam'atto saṅgām'āvacaro'ti?

41682.commentary: (SNt) yāva tettiṃsavassā'pi paṭhamavayo. paṇṇāsavassakāle'ti paṭhamavayato yāva paññāsavassakālā, tāva ṭhitā hotī'ti vuḍḍhihāniyo anupagantvā sarūpen'eva ṭhitā hoti.

ciṇṇā aṅgā ca magadhā, vajjī kāsī ca kosalā, anaṇā paṇṇāsavassāni, raṭṭhapiṇḍaṃ abhuñj'ahaṃ.

nārado sabbaṃ taṃ pavattiṃ ācikkhitvā iminā kāraṇena ahaṃ iminā abhisapito, ath'āhaṃ, mayhaṃ doso n'atthi, yassa doso atthi, tass'eva upari abhisapo patatū'ti vatvā abhisapiṃ

41692.commentary: (ANa) cutā patantī'ti ye cutā, te patanti nāma. patitā'ti ye patitā, te cutā nāma.

examples.text: so kho ahaṃ, sāriputta, tam'eva kāyaṃ assāsento pāṇinā gattāni anomajjāmi. tassa mayhaṃ, sāriputta, pāṇinā gattāni anomajjato pūtimūlāni lomāni kāyasmā patanti tāy'ev'app'āhāratāya.

41699.commentary: (DNa) narakapapātaṃ papatanto'ti mayā gahitāya diṭṭhiyā ahaṃ narakapapātaṃ papatanto.

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, lohicco brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, seyyathā'pi, bho gotama, puriso purisaṃ narakapapātaṃ patantaṃ kesesu gahetvā uddharitvā thale patiṭṭhapeyya, evam'ev'āhaṃ bhotā gotamena narakapapātaṃ papatanto uddharitvā thale patiṭṭhāpito.
